objective: Restore Distributor Collections rendering and permanently enforce the PostgreSQL-numeric to application-money serialization contract.

incidentContract.userObservedFailure: Admin Distributor Status / Distributor Collections is non-responsive because production projection money values are JSON numbers and formatInr calls split directly on them.
incidentContract.authoritativeExpectedResult: The canonical Distributor API serializes PostgreSQL numeric projection money as two-decimal strings and the UI renders numeric display inputs without crashing.
incidentContract.writePath: Unchanged; this task performs no business or production data writes.
incidentContract.readPath: public.distributor_financial_projection_v1 to GET /api/distributors to Distributor Collections UI.
incidentContract.acceptanceInvariant: Projection values 0, 400, and 400.5 serialize as 0.00, 400.00, and 400.50 strings; numeric-wire browser data renders INR 400 and INR 600 without throwing.

budgets.dataAuthority: Receivables and the authoritative PostgreSQL projection remain financial authority; normalization is serialization only.
budgets.readBudget: Unchanged bounded Distributor list and metrics requests; maximum normal list page remains 50.
budgets.failureMode: Malformed unexpected RPC money values fail at the server boundary; finite numeric display inputs are normalized defensively.
budgets.testPlan: Focused unit/API regression, Distributor E2E numeric wire mock, typecheck, scoped lint, build, diff check, and Graph status/proof.

acceptance.description: The Distributor API boundary deterministically normalizes trusted finite string or number projection money to canonical two-decimal strings, rejects malformed values, and formatInr defensively accepts string or number without changing financial authority.

Focused unit coverage proves 0, 400, and 400.5 numeric wire values become canonical strings; Distributor E2E uses numeric money at least once and renders INR 400 and INR 600; typecheck, scoped lint, production build, and git diff check pass.
POSTGRES_NUMERIC_WIRE_CONTRACT_RULE and WIRE_MOCK_REALISM_RULE are persisted as COMPILED in the Graph lessons registry with implementation and regression protection.

A focused hotfix PR has green required CI and READY Vercel Preview, is merged normally, the resulting main production deployment is READY, and production logs are inspected read-only without dummy data.
